item.title: Distros — Android (AOSP)
item.description: To run Android on real hardware you can now flash RISE developer images for the K3 Pico-ITX / A210 EVB; it is still a validation-grade release, so do not treat it as a usable system. ｜ Based on AOSP (Linux kernel + Android framework)
